decisions.boundary_condition: Treat this as a soft queen-bed preference, not a general queen-or-larger rule and not an inference from party size.
decisions.condition: When selecting a hotel room and the current trip does not require a different bed configuration.
decisions.default_action: Prioritize or request a queen-size bed.
decisions.exception_condition: Honor an explicit request for twin beds, a king bed, or another room-specific sleeping arrangement instead.
decisions.name: hotel_queen_bed_preference
decisions.preference_value: Prefers a queen-size bed for hotel rooms when no different sleeping arrangement is requested.
decisions.rationale: Multiple hotel-room examples support queen-size accommodation as a recurring preference, while also showing that explicit trip-specific bed configurations override it. The evidence is mixed between an exact queen request and queen-or-king acceptability, so this remains a soft queen default rather than a minimum-size rule.
